limitations: Substring presence, qualifier adjacency and numeric differences do not establish semantic correctness.
Short spans and answers ending inside sentences are often legitimate; flags are not rejection rules.
PDF source_text is the reviewed transcription, not a PDF byte-offset coordinate system.
SQuAD support is its full scoped paragraph; TAT-QA matches may include wrong-scope duplicate cells.
Cause/effect, definitions, quantity roles, dates, units and spelled-out numbers need manual review.
No labels or captured model scores are modified. Sealed records are excluded.

new_manual_review_leads.question: What was the baseline model?

new_manual_review_leads.question: How does their model improve interpretability compared to softmax transformers?
new_manual_review_leads.concern: Sparse attention is the method and specialization/confidence the reported benefit. Decide whether the short method-only alternative adequately answers how interpretability improves or needs the explicit mechanism.

new_manual_review_leads.question: What are labels in car speak language dataset?
new_manual_review_leads.concern: The paper says labels identify the car model, ignoring its year. Decide whether bare car is a sufficient categorical label or too underspecified; do not confuse model, manufacturer and individual vehicle.

new_manual_review_leads.question: What type of punishment is sometimes offered to civil disobedients?
